text:
Hey! Here's what happened with the nightly job.

The root cause was disk space. The volume hit 98% full, so the job didn't have room to do its work and failed.

Why it filled up: log rotation was disabled back in January. Since then, logs have been piling up with nothing cleaning them out, and last night they finally pushed the disk over the edge.

To fix it, I freed up about 40 GB and reran the job manually. The rerun succeeded at 02:40, so last night's output should be complete.

A few follow-ups I'd suggest so this doesn't happen again:
• Turn log rotation back on so logs stop building up
• Add a disk usage alert (maybe at 85%) so we hear about it well before anything breaks
• Find out why rotation was turned off in January, in case it was on purpose and something depends on it

I'm happy to take the rotation fix myself if nobody else is already on it. Let me know if you have questions or want more detail on what I cleaned up!
